enrichment_factor_formula: EF_topk = (hits_in_topk / k) / (hits_total / n) within each arm
fdr_method: Benjamini-Hochberg, alpha=0.10, across all round compounds
go_no_go: continue if EF>=2.0 at top-k for model_ranked vs diversity_random AND >=1 clean novel chemotype confirmed; max planned rounds 3
primary_endpoint: TEVC alpha9alpha10 potentiation: active = potency>0 AND potentiation>0; hits re-confirmed by independent dose-response
